lm_school.title: The Collapsed School
lm_school.text:
Class Log
Present: 7 (Minjae, Hayun, Dohyun, Seoa, Junwoo, Jiho, the friend with no name)
1st period reading. Only two textbooks so we passed them around. Dohyun still mixes up his spelling
2nd period counting. Mostly addition, for weighing scrap. Seoa is the fastest
Notes: the lanes on the field were drawn again. Same yesterday. They avoided the cracks but nobody knows who did it. The kids say they don't know. The fallen basketball hoop is still there
To do: plaster pieces for chalk, 2 buckets of water, sweep the classroom floor
Seems pretty tired today

lm_hospital.title: The Collapsed Hospital
lm_hospital.text:
Hospital raid number 3
Found
- amoxicillin 2 strips (no idea about expiry, took it anyway)
- ibuprofen 1 bottle
- a little bit of bandage
- IV bags 3 (no tubing, damn)
Didn't find
- no insulin at all
- strong antibiotics (penicillin? penicilin?)
The bastards who came before tore out the whole med cabinet. Scraped the bottoms of the drawers too. Not even the manners to leave some
The ambulance, no point looking. Empty
The red cross is still hanging up there. who do they think is gonna protect them. I just laugh now
3rd floor next

lm_station.title: The Collapsed Station
lm_station.text:
Day 41 of walking
Lord, today too I walked about fourteen thousand steps along the tracks (is it "I walketh"? whatever)
Lord, if you give me one bottle of water I swear I won't complain tomorrow. This is a deal. You didn't give me any yesterday so with interest it has to be two
Reached the station today. The glass roof is all broken so I got rained on. Slept in a rusty train car. At least there are seats
In the beginning there was a train and the train came not
Look at my knees, Lord. Pretending you don't see them hurts my feelings
Amen tomorrow

lm_highway.title: The Broken Overpass
lm_highway.text:
DON'T COME UP!!!
THIS IS MY SPOT!!!!
Put wire under the stairs. Not my fault if you trip
3rd. three guys from below passed by. don't stare. one was looking at me
5th. rebar shaking. somebody touched it from underneath for sure
6th. somebody went in the car stuck at the end and came out. signs of it. not my stuff. not mine I said
9th. I told you DON'T COME UP!!!!!
* I remember the face of the guy who stole my water bottle. If I see him again he's dead
* Don't write on the walls

lm_amusement.title: The Abandoned Amusement Park
lm_amusement.text:
Ferris Wheel Rules (made by the boss)
1. Always listen to the boss. The boss is me
2. The highest car is the boss's seat. Nobody climbs up there
3. Don't go near the roller coaster. Juni hurt his leg last time
4. If you find food you bring it all. Hide it and you skip a meal
5. If a grown-up comes you hide. no matter what. There are no nice grown-ups
6. People who cry at night sleep in the bottom car. If you're loud it's big trouble
Hyuna said 6 is too mean. so crying is ok but you have to cry quietly now
7. Saying you didn't know the rules doesn't work

lm_mall.title: The Abandoned Mall
lm_mall.text:
Ledger (spot in front of the stopped escalator)
In / Out
water filter 1 <- gave 4kg scrap (pricey but I think I can make it back reselling)
batteries 6 -> got 2 cans + 1kg scrap
found matching shoes and tied them up -> made a little profit
Haggling memo: the lady by the dry fountain cuts the price every time. won't sell to her next time. same one who insisted the batteries were duds
No credit (the old guy by the fountain still owes 2kg)
Made about 1.5kg today?
Don't put stuff where the ceiling glass falls. Broke one yesterday. total loss

lm_cathedral.title: The Collapsed Cathedral
lm_cathedral.text:
Bell work memo
The bell itself is fine, the problem is the clapper joint and the rope
Need to get
- bearing about 8cm across (get it from the motor at the processing plant)
- thick steel cable 6m
- if no lubricant try animal fat
- clapper pin
Rang it today and the sound is a half note low. Don't know if it's the crack or the hanging angle. Check the angle again tomorrow
The spire broke so the tower got lower, but maybe the ring is actually fine
Haven't gone into the priest's room. Doubt there are any parts
Just need it to sound right

lm_subway.title: Subway Entrance
lm_subway.text:
Subway Measurement Record
Entrance stairs 38 steps, bottom 6 buried in debris
Width 2.4m height 17cm
About 62m to the first platform
From platform end to tunnel mouth 40m west
3 flooded sections, depth 20~35cm
Gas detector went off twice, stopped measuring
One train stopped 200m into the tunnel. All doors open, no people
A briefcase was still on a seat
Next measurement confirmed to start from after the train

lm_powerplant.title: Power Plant Cooling Tower
lm_powerplant.text:
Work Log
Don't know how long I've lived here. The people who fixed things with me all left
Valve 3 is leaking again. Third time this month
Gauge reads 4.2 morning 5.9 afternoon. Red zone. At first I was scared but now it all looks the same
Filled the crack in the cooling tower with putty. It'll break soon anyway, does this change anything
A guy from the next village asked what's the point of fixing this, so I asked him what he does to live. He couldn't answer
Cleaning out the office drawer I found a cup ramen. Expiry date almost rubbed off. How long since I had cup ramen....boiled it and ate it, it was fine
Tomorrow I plan to look at the valve first

lm_apartments.title: The Collapsed Apartment Complex
lm_apartments.text:
October 8
Seongho, the door isn't locked, just push in. No food but there's water

September 20
Seongho, it's your dad. The 3rd floor balcony collapsed so come up the side stairs. Don't come from the front

August
Seongho, your father is home. Haven't moved out yet
Don't let anyone else in because the house looks empty. I'm still here

The application I sent to the management office didn't go through, they say. It's fine. You need somewhere to come to

lm_bridge.title: The Broken Suspension Bridge
lm_bridge.text:
Toll
Person 1kg scrap
If you have bags 1kg extra
Cart 3kg

Anyone asking for a discount doesn't cross. Stop talking. it's all the same story
You can only go to the end of the deck that's left
Don't go near the broken cables. Not my fault if you fall
Some guys say they'll cross by the riverbed. do what you want. never seen anyone put a foot in that water and come out fine
I don't take anyone at night. Never seen anyone who could come at night anyway

lm_airport.title: Airport Control Tower
lm_airport.text:
Flight Log
Captain: me
Weather: a little smog, wind seems northwest. No flag so I can't tell
A big plane is lying in the middle of the runway. What are the people who clear that doing
Tried the control tower radio, just static. Still ask for takeoff clearance every morning
No response
Standby again today
Inside the plane's tail blocks the wind, good for sleeping
Only the wind noise is a bit too loud
If I go up there is the sky clearer? What would it feel like?

a01.title: Day One
a01.text:
I opened my eyes and only cold rain was falling on my face
I'm pretty sure I was lying in my own home spacing out, I have no clue why I'm stuck in this junkyard
My face stings from the rain so I think it's acid rain. So I crawled into somewhere anyway
Yesterday's me would've laughed at the state of me now
Still, I found something in the junkyard so I can at least write this. should I be glad about that
It looked like acid rain but I boiled it and drinking it was okay I think
Went into an old building and delivery drones or whatever are trying to kill me
Drones trying to kill people here? haha...what a state I'm in
Somehow I took down a drone and now I carry scrap around. I read somewhere a weird guy in a robe buys scrap so I kept it
Don't know when I'll find him
First I'm really hungry so I have to look for food
I'll be alive tomorrow, right?

a02.title: Day Two
a02.text:
Well, I survived
The wild dogs were so loud yesterday I couldn't sleep properly...can't even sleep, what am I doing...ugh
Still, glad I'm alive
Searched that building yesterday, nothing. All I got was scraps of paper
Just went somewhere else. Figured staying there would only get me a speck of dust
Found a collapsed shop and got some canned food, but one was already swollen and about to burst so I threw it out
It was some weird stew so I barely got it down. tasted awful but eating anything made me feel alive
Couldn't find the guy in the robe today either. The scrap keeps making noise and it's driving me crazy. At least I ate so today was bearable

a03.title: Day Five
a03.text:
Couldn't write for a few days
The rain wouldn't stop so I was stuck in some cave. Only had boiled rainwater and I even rationed that
Finally found the guy in the robe today. Heard someone so I followed
Showed him the scrap, he looked at it without a word and gave me one block thing and half a bottle of water. Days of jingling around carrying it and this is all
Asked for more and he doesn't even look at me. If a person talks you should answer
Chewing something gave my legs a bit of strength. Have to save the water
Asked where he's from and all he said was he doesn't go out on rainy days, then he pulled his cart away
Need to collect more scrap. Noisy or not, no choice...

a04.title: Day Six
a04.text:
Bad dust storm, the sky is yellow. Sand in my mouth even with cloth wrapped around it, no use
Couldn't see so I walked along a wall and came to a building like a hospital. Half a red cross was left
Went in hoping for medicine but the cabinet was already torn apart. Someone had been here first. Only empty pill bottles rolling around
In the corner of the 3rd floor there was a blanket and an empty water bottle on a bed. Looks like someone lived here. Over a dozen date scratches on the wall and writing
help me...help me....help me...help me........help me...help me........help me...help me........help me...help me.....kill me......kill me......kill me......kill me......
Did they go crazy. Where did they go. did they leave or couldn't leave
Took the blanket. Sorry but I have to live too
On the way back the dust cleared a bit and I barely found my way

a05.title: Day 12
a05.text:
I'm losing track of the days. Let's just say about day 12
Keep thinking about what was written on the wall on the 3rd floor. That person probably counted days at first like me
Today I was digging under a collapsed shelf and the whole shelf fell over. The crash echoed everywhere
Not long after I heard footsteps. Many of them in step. Boots
Barely found a pile of trash and crawled in and held my breath. Guys wearing black gear looked around where I'd been for a long time, then left
They must be people but I wasn't glad at all. They didn't come looking for me
After they left I saw the floor where the shelf was had a dent in it
Tried to crawl out but my legs gave out and I can't move for a while so I'm just writing this
help me...help me please....I want to live

a06.title: Day ?
a06.text:
How many days now? Don't remember how much time passed since I said day 12
These days I hear scraping on sheet metal every night. Definitely not wild dogs. Heavier and slower
Saw what it was today in the daytime. Shaped like a dog but the whole body is steel. Only the eyes glow red
A wild dog was hanging around near it and got dragged off in a second
I hid in the trash pile and just breathed until it left
Seems to go alone but I don't know
To live I should learn the paths it walks, but then I wonder what's the use of knowing
Still, I want to live
help me...help me...please....I want to live

a07.title: Day ??
a07.text:
I decided I'm done counting what day it is. What's the use, it'll all be the same anyway
Met the guy in the robe again. No rain this time, nice weather for the Dead Zone
Nobody calls it the Dead Zone but I think nobody could argue with this
Held out the scrap I've collected and he gave me a bottle of water and a band-aid. Too many places need a band-aid, don't know where to start
Grabbed the sleeve of the guy about to leave and asked if there's anywhere safe around here
He stared a long while. If you want info give more scrap. nothing is free, he says
Even if the world ends, merchants are no different
Then I suddenly remembered I saw something while wandering about an old-style place called a bunker
A bunker....I think I saw it in an old book. but does a place like that still exist?
Could I live if I go there

a08.text:
My cough hasn't stopped for days. Did I drink too much rainwater. Boiled or not acid rain is still acid rain I guess
My throat hurts so I didn't go far today. Only picked through trash nearby and found nothing. It's probably all places I already searched
At dusk the ground shook. Boom from very far, and a long while later another boom
Thought it was thunder but the sky was totally fine
After the booms came a long sound of grinding metal. Sounded like something huge chewing the trash
Only after it stopped did I breathe. Don't even know how long I'd been holding my breath
That won't come this way, right?
Please let me live at least today
Have to find the bunker quick

a09.title: Don't Know
a09.text:
I really don't know the date anymore. Flipped back to the front of the notebook and it's definitely my handwriting but looks like someone else's
Cough is a little better today but now I get a fever every night. Shivering under the blanket until morning
Every dawn I keep hearing sounds, hallucinations or whatever
Today I found a rusty sign between the collapsed walls. Writing half rubbed off, only "SH LTER" and an arrow left
Bunker was also called shelter in the old days I think
The way the arrow points at least looks safe. Good. Really good
The sign is too heavy to carry so I scratched the direction on the back of my hand. Next to the number
Now I only go that way
Please be there

a10.title: Fourth Rain
a10.text:
Counting rainy days instead of dates. Today is the fourth rain
Still walking the way I wrote on my hand. Have to rest every time I cross a trash mountain. My legs aren't what they used to be
That strange sound again. This time it's so close I feel the ground shake in the soles of my feet
Was this the sound I heard every dawn? feels like it and also not
Today the grinding metal won't stop. I won't end up as that metal, right?
Still have to walk. If I stop that thing will come first
help me...help me...please...I want to live....no...rather...kill m(the paper is torn and the writing can't be seen)

a11.title: Last Page
a11.text:
I don't even know how many times it has rained now
I finally got here. Past the trash mountain I can see the corner of a rusty iron door. It was real
But my legs won't move anymore. The fever won't go down. The door is right there...but I can't move any more
Let me rest a little. just a little
The sound again. I'm not even scared now. just loud
The blanket was useful till now. at least I wasn't cold. Even if I want to give it back there's nobody to give it back to
If someone sees this go to that door. I couldn't make it
I want to live...really...so...much...I want to live....haha...almost there and look at me....what did I do wrong.....
No forget it. I just want to rest now. kill me, just do it

b01.title: Picture Diary
b01.text:
March 4 Weather: cloudy
Today we couldnt go out to the playground at school. Teacher said its because the air is bad
At recess I jumped rope in the gym and I got 1st place! 112!! Minsu only did 30. He says its because of his mask but I wore one too!!
There was no strawberry milk at lunch. They said no more strawberry milk. why???
When I got home mom and dad were watching tv and didnt say anything. The news said a computer said something but I dont get it
I asked mom are we moving and she said not yet. When is not yet?
Tomorrow bring indoor shoes and two bottles of water
Tomorrow I really want to play with my friends on the playground

b02.title: Handover Memo
b02.text:
Today was another day I really hated going to work. Night shift too so it feels even worse
The patients keep going around saying the newly launched AI said 95% or some percent or whatever
We're running out of medical supplies too so I can't even throw away bandages, I have to disinfect them in hot water and reuse them
Anyway for handover, patient **** and the people in ward *** on floor *** are scheduled for discharge, and I guess there's nothing much else
ps. Actually I'm also going into the wall so leaving early is a secret

b03.title: Announcement Script
b03.text:
Announcement script 5/** revision 3
Attention passengers
Today's last train departs at 21:30

Asked HQ again if it's really 21:30 and they still don't know
I don't think I've ever seen HQ do their job properly

The last train can only be boarded by those holding a ticket to the wall

Read this line a hundred times today. I could say it if someone just tapped me
Sick of it every time I see it now

Passengers without a ticket please wait in the waiting room for the next announcement

An old lady asked when the next announcement is and I said I don't know
HQ won't tell me so how would I know...I'd like to tell her but I don't know
Manager Kim says to do the announcement calmly but he's been yelling in the office since earlier

Please take one step back from the safety line

b04.title: Phone Memo
b04.text:
(ink smeared on one side of the screen. battery 3%)
Memo 5/**
Take the overpass then exit 3. if the national road is blocked the side road by the gas station

Half a tank, one tank gets us ***km but I can't work it out for half
The oldest keeps asking why we're leaving it at home. cried about leaving a toy and fell asleep
The second one keeps saying bathroom bathroom bathroom, doesn't even look tired
Their mom is reading the map upside down. Staying quiet in case we fight
Two hours on the overpass, same spot. The people in the cars ahead got out and started walking
Do we have to walk too. Can I make it with the kids
Wait for now

b05.title: Closing Checklist
b05.text:
Closing checklist April ** (last day open)
Carousel power off v
Ticket booth settlement v 12 customers today and 6 of them free tickets
Ferris wheel inspection v no wait it won't run from tomorrow anyway, why am I even inspecting it
Lost and found sorted. dozens of umbrellas alone. nobody comes for them
Boss says turn in the keys when we finish today and everybody do what you can. what am I supposed to do
Earlier a kid at the top of the Ferris wheel shouted that you can see a wall going up over there. I went up too and really, something was rising tall far away
Pay only until this month he says. Do we get no severance?
Still have to empty the trash cans.... it's the last day anyway, should I just leave it

b06.title: Text Messages
b06.text:
(the screen is cracked. battery 1%)
Manager 4/17 09:12
Change the 30% stickers to 50% today. by this morning
Me 09:15
Take off all the ones from yesterday?
Manager 09:15
yeah
Me 13:40
Manager the ramen and canned food are all gone. none in the storeroom either
Me 13:41
Some guy checked out three carts earlier. same guy just comes back in a different hat lol
Manager 14:02
dont worry about it
Me 18:30
Not one pair of sandals sold. what do we do
Me 18:31
Manager?
Me 21:10
I'm still coming in tomorrow right?

b07.title: Sermon Draft
b07.text:
Sermon for Mass, Second Sunday of March
Brothers and sisters, I know your hearts are heavy because of the news these days
No, too obvious. Start over

Today's gospel is about the lilies of the field. The part about not worrying about tomorrow, and it had to land on this week of all weeks
Last Sunday 60 came, this week maybe just over 40. They say everyone is lining up to sign up for the list
I got the application form too. It's still in the drawer
I'm supposed to tell the faithful not to worry and I haven't slept at all at night
Still, Sunday comes. I have to do the 10 o'clock Mass
Keep the sermon short. Everyone must be tired
Lord, today please look on me too

b08.title: Phone Memo
b08.text:
(screen is half off. battery 2%)
Memo 5/**
The 8:12 train stopped in the tunnel. Announcement only says wait a moment
Texted my team lead I'm late but no signal
Past 9. AC went off too. The sweat smell from the guy next to me is awful. maybe he can't wash
Someone in the front car is yelling to open the door
Report is due today, does this count as a reason for being late. should prepare to write an incident statement
10 o'clock. The driver got off and says walk to the next station. on the tracks
Walking watching only the back of the person ahead by my phone light. should save battery
When I get to the next station I have to call my team lead first

b09.title: Shift Work Log
b09.text:
Night shift log 5/2
20:00 Unit 1 turbine OK
21:00 Cooling pump B no problem. makes some noise but nothing different from usual
22:00 Transmission system OK
Official notice came that the transmission zones change starting today. Inside the wall first and the rest gets leftover power
Leftover power...that sounds like our neighborhood
Assistant Manager Park is sleeping in the break room again today. I did the rounds. Writing that down too
Tried to order a late snack but nobody picks up. Settled for cup ramen
23:00 Unit 1 turbine OK
Left one cup ramen in the next shift's drawer

b10.title: Apartment Notice
b10.text:
[Notice] Guide to Applying for Wall Residency
To the residents of Building ***
Applications are taken at the management office. One form per household
Please do not take two each
The management office doesn't know the selection criteria either. Asking me won't help
There's a rumor that households behind on maintenance fees don't get forms, this is not true
Still, we would appreciate it if you paid your fees while you're at it
Please don't pile belongings in front of the elevator at night. We understand how you feel if you're moving out but others use it too
Unit *** got another complaint about the dog barking
Just in case, I'm telling you
From the building rep

b11.title: The Unsent Letter
b11.text:
Honey
Calls keep not going through so I'm writing a letter. don't know when you'll get this
Yesterday I went all the way to the bridge
There was a huge line for the checkpoint
They looked at my ID and said my residence is different so I'm not eligible and can't cross
Your house is just one bridge over but it feels so far
I was wrong about the fight last time. Sorry I brought up the naengmyeon place. That place closed
I still wear the scarf you bought me. The air is bad these days so even with a mask please always wear a scarf
The news says the bridge restrictions will be lifted in a few days
When they are I'll cross first thing
I love you honey

The names and addresses of the sender and recipient are rubbed out.
b11.found: In a collapsed house near the bridge, you found an unsent letter in a drawer.

b12.title: Radio Log Sheet
b12.text:
Control radio log 5/** day shift
09:12 Tower -> NX*** runway 2, hold for takeoff

09:14 NX*** hold acknowledged

09:31 Tower -> NX*** takeoff clearance cancelled

10:05 Tower -> *** circle and hold

10:40 Tower -> xxxxxxx xxx xx xxxxx xxx

11:15 Tower -> *** cleared to land, runway 3, guide in

11: 20 Tower -> runways 1 and 2 are out of use from today. oh we're out of coffee

11: 20 Tower <- Tower...Tower, no chatter on the radio channel

c01.title: Delivery Guy
c01.text:
Outside the wall people said everyone who comes in has to do something so I'm scribbling this
Did deliveries 7 years. floors 14 to 31
They told me to get lost cause my rating dropped 0.3. said I got slow. my knee's been shot for ages, how about some medicine
The people on 31, 7 years and never saw their faces
Put the package in the slot and ring the bell once, ring twice and your rating drops. petty bastards, but at least I learned that for sure
On the way out the guard said I'm lucky because I'm walking out. what's that supposed to mean
The water here tastes awful

c02.title: Accountant
c02.text:
I wrote my name in the name box and they said names aren't needed here, erase it. so if I write this with no name would anyone know who I am?
They said I have to write something to get even a cup of water so I'm writing
Was an accountant. 15 years
I didn't sign one contract
They said if I sign they'd handle the work from now on. But I can't see the details. what kind of idiot accountant signs a document without knowing what's in it
That was last Monday and this morning I got kicked out the wall gate
The people I worked with all signed. They're probably doing fine by now
In line for water the person ahead asked me how much scrap one bucket of water costs
I just got here too, how would I know
Nobody here keeps a ledger. managing accounts this sloppily....
Don't know what else to write so I'll stop here

c03.title: Doctor
c03.text:
There's a box for occupation so I'll write it. I was head of surgery at **lin Hospital
My grade dropping wasn't my mistake. The records person entered the numbers wrong
Filed for review three times and got no answer
First thing I saw here was a guy pouring rust water on a wound. Says it's disinfecting. I told him do that if you want to die of sepsis and he says then you do it
No tools, no medicine, what am I supposed to do in a place like this
Earlier a kid had a torn leg so I stitched it with wire for now
No disinfectant, nothing, so infection is what it is
But my hands shook a little. Never happened before. must be the cold
The person handing out water called me doctor. First time I've heard that in a long while

c04.title: Voice Actor
c04.text:
Thank God it's writing. I couldn't have done it by speaking. With a voice like this
Did ad recordings for 8 years. That voice in the upper-level elevators, "have a perfect day today" blah blah
Read in a smiling tone nine hours a day. My throat started cracking and in half a year a replacement came
Replacement. they swap a person's voice like changing a part
On the last recording day the director said next, not even thanks for the work. The speaker played a voice exactly like mine. wow....it's my voice and it was better than me
Leaving the wall gate, that voice came from the billboard over my head
I asked someone here if there's water but my voice was hoarse and didn't come out right
I guess I won't have much reason to talk anymore

c05.title: Blank
c05.text:
Leaving the occupation box blank. If people here knew, scrap metal would fly at me instead of water
I was outside-the-wall surveillance, 3rd year. Disguised in the settlement and sent reports at set times. how many gathered, what they carry
I could still get supplies from somewhere near the wall
Got scared more than once or twice when people here almost caught me
But at some point supplies came once every 10 days. The last supply was over 40 days ago I think
At first I thought it was broken. Took the comm apart so many times and it's fine
Only after the food ran out I went to the contact post near the wall
Wow....my ID card wouldn't register....ha...3 years risking my life in this hellhole reporting
The thought hit me that this is how I get thrown away. But no...it must be a system error, I thought and came back for now
I'm still carrying the comm. just in case
If they contact me what do I say

c06.title: Child's Mother
c06.text:
I'll write my child's name first. my name doesn't matter. ****
My 7 year old baby's fever hasn't gone down for three days
They said it's a nervous system penalty or something. Reaction speed was below standard in the school test. fingers keep shaking and speech got slow. is that the child's fault. must be the bad mother's fault....
They said the child can't go out alone so I came along
Dad didn't come. said his grade would drop. jerk...abandoning his child to save himself...
In the water line I was carrying the child and the person ahead stepped aside and let me go first. People here seem better than the ones inside
Earlier the person who used to be a doctor looked at the child. No medicine for fever, just put a wet cloth on. I know that already
Is that person really a doctor?
Can't sleep again tonight....
Please just let the fever go down I'll do anything my baby.....

hidden.title: The Notebook in Their Arms
hidden.text:
A person sits leaning against a steel beam standing straight up from the ground. The head is bent.
A blanket is pulled up to the shoulders, and both arms hold something close.
The right arm looks half replaced with machine parts
When the arms are loosened a notebook with only its cover comes out. Few pages are left inside.
The torn-out places show it is the same notebook as the papers picked up around the dump.
On the back of the hand is an arrow that looks scratched in with something sharp.
The remaining pages are packed with writing. Only the last page looks short
They seem to have been alive until not long ago
